GenAiPlugin.description: Assign cards to team members, search for users, and check workload distribution.
GenAiPlugin.scope: Use this topic when the user wants to assign work to team members, find users, or check how work is distributed. This includes assigning a card to someone, setting a peer reviewer, searching for users by name, or checking a team member's current workload and story point allocation. Also use this when the user asks "who has bandwidth", "assign this to", or "what is [person] working on".
